issue.title: Relation label vocabulary — a chooser that works, hidden and one-off labels, and one global rename
issue.description: The Bob Mac Capture relation card is a reliable, beautiful chooser: Ctrl+N/P move a visible highlight through existing relation labels, Tab accepts, and nothing collapses. Relation labels can be hidden from suggestions (Ctrl+D, with undo), shown again (Ctrl+H section) and unhidden, created hidden with `~note:id||label` (with a clear warning when that hides an existing label), and renamed everywhere — from the card, `bob relations rename`, and Obsidian — in one previewed, revertable commit.
